topic: Surface roughness, meaning of real surface, geometrical surface, effective surface, and various irregularities
syllabus_extract: Surface roughness, meaning of real surface, geometrical surface, effective surface, and various irregularities.
specific_objectives: 10.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe details about Engineering Metrology.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of surface finish standards chart; Instructor supervision on terminology definitions
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of Engineering Metrology?
Can you name one tool used for measuring surface finish?
Why is surface finish critical in aircraft engine components?

development.content:
Definition of Real Surface
Definition of Geometrical Surface
Definition of Effective Surface
Distinction between Real and Geometrical
Role of Measurement Instruments

Classification of Surface Irregularities
Long Wavelength Irregularities
Short Wavelength Irregularities
Micro-roughness characteristics
Impact on friction and wear

Surface Roughness Parameters
Ra and Rz definitions
Relation to Geometrical Surface
Effective Surface concept
Practical implications in maintenance

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a real surface and a geometrical surface.
How do long wavelength irregularities differ from short wavelength irregularities?
Why is the effective surface important in engineering metrology?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how surface roughness affects the sealing efficiency of aircraft hydraulic components, referencing LP 02 concepts.
